name: ai.ordercore/ordercore-mcp
description: Commerce backend for AI agents: catalog search, prices, inventory, order history, and idempotent checkout (retry-safe, never double-charges). 9 tools over a real orders API.

environment_variables.name: ORDERCORE_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: OrderCore API key. Optional: omit for a zero-config read-only sandbox on the demo catalog; set a full read/write key (free, 2 fields, no payment) from https://ordercore.ai/bootstrap to enable checkout.
